summary: Logistic Properties of the Americas (NYSE American: LPA), a Cayman-domiciled, Costa Rica-headquartered Latin American logistics REIT, disclosed receipt of definitive antitrust approval from Peru's INDECOPI for its previously announced $145.0 million sale of Parque Logístico Lima Sur, a 1.3 million square foot logistics park, to Peruvian diversified REIT FIBRA Prime. Only customary administrative closing items remain; no expected close date, board recommendation, or advisor was stated. Roughly $85.0 million of net pre-tax proceeds are earmarked for redeployment into Mexico. Watch closing timing, Peru tax leakage on proceeds, and execution risk on Mexican capital recycling.
